title: Sequential-f32 ULP Repair-Capacity Audit

scope.purpose: characterize local sequential-f32 readout authority of all legal isolated one-ULP moves around fresh Q10-SM committed safe endpoints

engineering_scope.endpoint_generation: rerun the frozen Q10-SM constructor and all continuous plus committed 32-ULP gates on each fresh event state
engineering_scope.no_safe_endpoint_handling: retain in coverage denominator as NOT_APPLICABLE__NO_SAFE_ENDPOINT

stage_a_requires: later explicit source and execution authorization
stage_entry.stage_b_entry_rule: Stage A lineage, endpoint, move enumeration, sequential-f32, factorization, relaxed-budget, receipt, and independent-review gates pass without any contract change
stage_entry.change_after_stage_a: requires a new protocol identity and fresh engineering seeds

alternate_admission: all Q10-SM continuous integrity gates pass
all Q10-SM committed support and boundary gates pass
no clipping or nonfinite value occurred

sequential_f32_readout.operation: scalar binary32 addition in stored source-coordinate order with binary32 rounding after each addition
sequential_f32_readout.optimized_rule: only touched rows may be recomputed, but every touched row restarts at positive zero and follows the complete learner source order
sequential_f32_readout.stage_a_reference_gate: optimized evaluator agrees bitwise with an independent full scalar reference

legality: resulting bit pattern is distinct and exactly adjacent in the named direction
result is finite and strictly inside the frozen weight bounds
only one coordinate in I_t changes
outside-support and fixed coordinates remain bitwise unchanged
lower and upper boundary membership remain exact
no new boundary member is created
at least 31 legal nextafter32 steps remain before boundary contact in each direction
no clipping, saturation, stochastic rounding, or model RNG is used
one_ulp_move_bank.candidate_evaluation: temporary immutable counterfactual from W_N_32; discard after readout
one_ulp_move_bank.effect: v_j[k] = f64(g_seq32(W_N_32 with move j)[k]) - f64(g_N[k])
one_ulp_move_bank.conceptual_matrix: R = [v_1, ..., v_m] in R^(q x m)
one_ulp_move_bank.zero_effect_definition: candidate readout bitwise equals g_N in every row
one_ulp_move_bank.incomplete_enumeration_policy: event or run is incomplete and cannot be summarized from a subset

rank_and_projection.gram_gate: Stage A independent replay agrees on rank, singular values, and retained-subspace projection within integrity tolerance
rank_and_projection.already_equal_rule: if every g_N row is bitwise equal to g_T, set rho_2 and rho_inf to zero and do not estimate correction budget
required_metrics: maximum absolute bank-column inner product with e_unreachable

relaxed_correction_budget.definition: x_dagger = -R^+ e using only singular values above tau_rank
relaxed_correction_budget.property: unique minimum-Euclidean-norm unconstrained real coefficient vector satisfying R x_dagger = -e_reachable
required_metrics: coefficient count with abs(x) greater than 1e-12
coefficient fraction with abs(x) greater than 1e-12
positive, negative, and bitwise-zero effect counts
locally helpful and harmful move counts relative to e_k
best single-move reduction divided by abs(e_k)

required_event_receipt: lineage hashes, seed, side, tau, trial, and endpoint status
base, true, alternate, support, and row-order hashes
Q10-SM continuous and committed safety receipts
baseline sequential-f32 values and bit patterns
error vector and per-row ULP distance
candidate, legal, illegal-by-reason, zero-effect, and active move counts
deterministic digest of every move coordinate, direction, resulting bits, touched rows, and effect bits
rank, threshold, singular-value, projection, relaxed-budget, and bottleneck metrics
no-mutation, no-RNG, no-repair, no-multi-move, no-scientific-seed, and no-behavior receipts

aggregate_reporting.post_hoc_groups: descriptive only and may not alter frozen audit

fields: implementation source manifest and executable hash
scalar reference and optimized incidence evaluator
complete move enumeration and legality implementation
matrix factorization backend and deterministic settings
observer invariance, no-mutation, no-RNG, no-repair, and fail-closed tests

required_tests_before_future_execution: Q10-SM constructor and endpoint compatibility on frozen fixtures
nextafter32 adjacency for signed zero, subnormal, exponent-transition, and near-bound values
support, boundary, no-clipping, and 31-step remaining-reserve gates
optimized g_seq32 bitwise equality with scalar reference
immutable W_N_32 baseline for every candidate
sparse conceptual R equality with dense fixture matrix
rank and projection agreement with independent factorization
pseudoinverse reconstruction and orthogonality within 2e-10 normalized tolerance
no simulation RNG, learner mutation, repair, behavior, scientific seeds, nonfinite output, or silent truncation

status_semantics.Q10_RC_VALID__CAPACITY_CHARACTERIZED: measurement receipts are valid; it does not imply error span, small relaxed budget, or discrete repair existence
status_semantics.Q10_RC_VALID__NO_APPLICABLE_SAFE_ENDPOIN: integrity is valid but the frozen Q10-SM constructor yields no accepted endpoint on fresh states
status_semantics.Q10_RC_VALID__NUMERICALLY_AMBIGUOUS: lineage is intact but a predeclared numerical degeneracy prevents reliable characterization
status_semantics.Q10_RC_INVALID: one or more lineage, coverage, legality, arithmetic, numerical, mutation, seed, or firewall gates failed

capacity_repair_separation.interpretation: rank, projection, and relaxed budget characterize a local readout vocabulary and cannot establish a realizable repair

claims_explicitly_forbidden: simultaneous axis, norm, support, boundary, reserve, or direction control
assumptions: All weights, bounds, and readouts are finite IEEE-754 binary32 values; NaN and infinity fail closed.
Q10-SM source-coordinate order, support, boundary, and 32-ULP semantics remain unchanged.
A legal move consumes at most one reserve step and must leave at least 31 legal steps toward each bound.
Every move effect is evaluated from the same immutable committed W_N_32 endpoint.
Sparse move effects may be represented compactly if they reproduce the complete conceptual matrix exactly.
The rank threshold and pseudoinverse share one retained singular subspace.
The relaxed minimum-L2 coefficient vector is a numerical authority diagnostic, not a legal move plan.
Per-row summed positive and negative authority are non-composable descriptive quantities.
Fresh engineering states may yield a different accepted-endpoint count from Q10-SM; no minimum count is inferred from the parent result.
No future qualification or scientific gate may be selected from Q10-RC behavioral evidence because Q10-RC observes no behavior.
